data.title: Islamic Affairs Ministry Holds Guidance Session for Guests of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques' Umrah Program
data.content:
Madinah, October 12, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance held a guidance session in Madinah for the fourth group of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques' Umrah and Visit Program, featuring Imam Sheikh Dr. Khalid Al-Muhanna.
    Al-Muhanna encouraged the guests to be grateful to Allah for the gift of Islam, emphasizing that gratitude is among the highest expressions of faith.
    The fourth group comprises 250 Umrah pilgrims from 21 countries.
    -- SPA
